name: Infernal Pummeling makes Melt raise Flames of Xoroth/Skulltaker damage taken by 10% (#1387)
contract: Infernal Pummeling 680900 reads 'Melt now increases the damage your target takes from Flames of Xoroth and Skulltaker by 10%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). The client's own moa_description agrees on the 10% value but Melt's (803334) own description string names 'Blade of Xoroth and Flames of Xoroth' instead of Skulltaker - stale text: Melt's own inert EFFECT_1 (native aura 271, SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER) carries SpellClassMask (0,3,0), which is exactly Skulltaker's (800168, dword1 bit0) and Flames of Xoroth's (801059, dword1 bit1) combined family flags, not Blade of Xoroth's (dword1 bit31); bindmysoul's text is what the classmask actually implements. Infernal Pummeling's own baked effect is a stray SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 flat modifier scoped to Melt's own classmask instead of a damage-taken bonus; AscensionXorothContracts.cpp nulls it and reads its 10 value directly via Amount(680900), applied to Melt's EFFECT_1 base value only while the caster has aura 680900 (ModifySpellEffectBaseValue, id == 803334, index == 1). Unit::CalculateSpellDamageTaken already folds SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER in natively, matched by caster GUID and SpellClassMask.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

Flames of Xoroth, with the enhanced Melt debuff
CONTRACT: the second hit deals ~10% more damage than the first
